name: Biology PhD
summary: Full-time biology PhD with research areas in environmental/ecological science and biomedical sciences. Applicants must identify a Biology graduate faculty mentor before applying; GRE is not required.
detailsNote: Official information available. The April 30 (fall) and September 30 (spring) deadlines are undated on the program page, so they are not confirmed for Fall 2027. Lab model: the page requires a Biology faculty mentor before applying and one letter from a UD Biology faculty mentor. The international page lists default deadlines only for programs that state none, so they are not used here.

applicationFee.note: Graduate admissions FAQ: international applicants pay $50 from Spring 2027 and all applicants from Summer 2027. No waiver is mentioned.

documents: Official transcripts from all colleges and universities attended (sent directly)
Personal statement (previous experience, areas of interest, professional goals)
Identify a Biology graduate faculty mentor before applying
International applicants: course-by-course credential evaluation, English proficiency proof
requirements.note: Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale. Bachelor's degree in biology or a substantially equivalent degree. Two letters from former or current professors or employers; one from a UD Biology faculty mentor. Preferred preparation (two years of chemistry, one year of math, one semester of physics and genetics) is not a fixed requirement. Students must be full-time.

funding.note: Catalog: students admitted to the doctoral program are given priority for fellowships, traineeships and research or teaching assistantships; appointments carry tuition exemption. The international page says the university offers no financial aid or merit scholarships to international graduate students, though a few assistantships are available. No page says all admitted students are funded; no stipend amount found.

international.note: A foreign credential evaluation and English proficiency proof are required.
